en: Apps looks like macOS's Apps view: recent apps first, then every app by name, with category chips.
Windows can show every window at its own shape, as in Mission Control.
Search filters as you type, also while a Chinese input method composes, and finds Chinese names by pinyin.
Animations when switching views and searching; window cards tilt under the pointer.
Double-clicking an app in Recent no longer opens the wrong one.
zh-Hans: “App”页面改成 macOS“App”视图的样式：先是最近打开的 App，再按名称列出全部 App，并可按类别筛选。
“窗口”页面可以像调度中心一样，按各窗口自身的形状显示所有窗口。
搜索会随输入实时筛选，中文输入法正在输入拼音时也会，并能用拼音找到中文名称。
切换视图和搜索时有动画；鼠标移到窗口卡片上，卡片会随之倾斜。
双击“最近使用”中的 App 不会再打开错的 App。
